title: {p} & {v} Potato Pie
steps: Heat the oven to 400°F (200°C). Boil the {s} until tender, then drain and mash with a little oil or milk.
Brown the {p} with the {spice}, then add the {v} and cook until soft.
Stir in the {sauce} and simmer 10 minutes, then spread in a baking dish and top with the mash.
Bake 20 to 25 minutes, until golden and bubbling and the filling is at least 165°F / 74°C.
tip: Use lean meat or lentils, lots of veg in the filling, and mash with a little milk instead of butter.
